title: Chassis Load Status incorrectly displays 'OK' when status is unknown
description: When viewing the Chassis Load Status, the application incorrectly displays 'OK' despite the actual status not being available, indicating a potential issue with status reporting.
steps: Tap on 'Controller List' under 'Current Site Information'.
Tap on the indicator next to 'Chassis Load Status' to expand the details.
actual: The Chassis Load Status displays 'OK' with 0% and '0.3 A of 22 A'. However, when the details are expanded, 'Chassis 1' shows a load of '1%' and '0.3 A of 22 A', but the status is not explicitly 'OK'.
expected: The Chassis Load Status should accurately reflect the actual status of the chassis. If the status is unknown or not 'OK', it should not be labeled as such.
